title: 第1章：天崩开局
slug: 流放路上捡破烂两岁萌娃养肥全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“救命，救……救救我！”

八月，酷暑。

一个两岁多的小女孩儿，在河水里扑腾着。

强大的求生本能，令她想抓住一切能救命的东西。

可河面上什么都没有，她的小手抓了一个空。

她看向站在岸边，七八岁大的女孩儿，像是在看最后的救命稻草。

“姐姐……”

“去死吧！要不是你外祖，我们也不会被抄家流放！”

女孩儿双手环胸，冷眼看着苏安安在河水里挣扎。

直到看见河水没过苏安安的头顶，她的脸上才浮现出一抹笑容。

“安安……”

她刚要转身离开，身后突然传来一道焦急的女声。

她被吓得脸色一变，下意识地转头看向来人。

只见苏安安的娘秦昭岚，用蛮力挣脱枷锁，飞快地向这边跑来。

不等她回过神，秦昭岚一头扎进河里。

女孩儿往后退了一步，转身往大部队的方向跑。

她一边跑一边在心里安慰自己，只要苏安安死了，就没人知道是她故意将她推下去的！

苏安安有意识时，只觉得浑身冰凉，像是被泡在冰水里。

她抬起手，奋力往上游。

脑袋刚从水面上冒出头，一道女声忽而传入耳里。

“安安别怕，娘这就来救你！”

她从小在孤儿院长大，哪来的娘？

等等，娘不是古代的称呼吗？

苏安安意识到不对，赫然睁开眼眸。

一段陌生的记忆，忽而袭上脑海。

这里是大周朝，原主是永宁侯府四房所出的孙小姐，三个月前刚满两岁。

她的父亲是永宁侯之子，母亲是镇国大将军的女儿。

而她的上面，还有三个宠爱她的哥哥。

昨日，前线传来镇国大将军以身殉国的消息。

原主的娘还没来得及悲伤，圣旨便传到了永宁侯府。

圣旨上说，前线战败是因有人暗中掉包了武器，用破烂货以次充好。

而这个人，正是原主的外祖父。

一夜之间，镇国将军府被判满门抄斩。

作为嫁出去的女儿，原主的娘和其夫家也受到了牵连，被判抄家流放。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Help, help...help me!"

August, sweltering heat.

A little girl over two years old was splashing in the river.

Her strong survival instinct makes her want to grab anything that can save her life.

But there was nothing on the river, and her little hand grabbed nothing.

She looked at the seven or eight-year-old girl standing on the shore, as if looking at the last straw.

"Sister..."

"Go to hell! If it hadn't been for your grandfather, we wouldn't have been confiscated and exiled!"

The girl crossed her chest with her hands and watched Su Anan struggling in the river with cold eyes.

It wasn't until she saw the river water covering Su Anan's head that a smile appeared on her face.

"An'an..."

Just as she was about to turn around and leave, an anxious female voice suddenly came from behind her.

She was so frightened that her expression changed, and she subconsciously turned her head to look at the person coming.

I saw Su An'an's mother, Qin Zhaolan, breaking free from the shackles with brute force and running towards this side quickly.

Before she could recover, Qin Zhaolan plunged into the river.

The girl took a step back, turned around and ran in the direction of the large army.

As she ran, she comforted herself in her heart. As long as Su Anan died, no one would know that she pushed her down on purpose!

When Su Anan was conscious, she felt cold all over, as if she was soaked in ice water.

She raised her hands and swam upward.

Just as his head emerged from the water, a female voice suddenly reached his ears.

"An'an, don't be afraid, mother will come to save you right now!"

She grew up in an orphanage. Where did she come from?

Wait, isn’t mother an ancient title?

Su Anan realized something was wrong and opened her eyes suddenly.

A strange memory suddenly came to mind.

This is the Zhou Dynasty, and the original owner is Miss Sun, who was born in the fourth room of Yongninghou Mansion. She just turned two years old three months ago.

Her father is the son of Yongninghou, and her mother is the daughter of the general Zhenguo.

And above her, there are three brothers who dote on her.

Yesterday, news came from the front line that the general Zhenguo died for his country.

Before the mother of the original owner had time to grieve, the imperial edict was sent to the Yongning Marquis Mansion.

The imperial edict stated that the defeat on the front line was due to someone secretly switching weapons and replacing them with junk goods.

And this man was the original owner's grandfather.

Overnight, the entire Zhenguo General Mansion was sentenced to death.

As a married daughter, the original owner's mother and her husband's family were also implicated and were sentenced to confiscation of their homes and exile.
